course: For me, the most useless course I have ever taken. First of all, it doesn't have a structured content that is to be taught. Secondly, the "in information systems" part in the name of the course is totally deceitful. This course barely even related to information systems - there are a maximum of 10 minutes worth of the course that was designated to the relation of ethics to information systems. The rest of it was just searching extremely basic things on the internet that a third year student already knows, or can spend literally 15 mins in their room to look over the internet. Assigning this many hours to a course like this is an extreme waste of time. For future students, get ready to sit in class sleepy, bored, and wondering "what am I even doing here?" after spending 6 hours in other subject's lecture hours. To the administration, kindly replace this course from the curriculum - the time can be utilized for something much better. It's not just me who is suggesting this, you can ask the entire batch and every single student will testify they felt the exact same. After a whole semester of taking classes, I can honestly claim I literally haven't learned a single thing, or anything better than what I could've understood in my room in 15 minutes (for the entire course).
